title: Students without enrollments
statementMd:
Count students with fewer than 4 enrollments (zero counts).

Expected columns: `students`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS students FROM (SELECT s.id FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id HAVING COUNT(e.course_id) < 4);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
